text:
Maya Lopez: Hi team 0th May LHR stay 0: hotel put a 300 incidental hold on the corporate card at check-in. Card declined for hold so I used personal card for incidentals and paid 34.50 in minibar + 6.00 ATM cash withdrawal fee when topping up to pay taxi after checkout. Want to know: 1) do we reimburse ATM cash withdrawal fees? 2) how to code the incidental split vs room charge?
Priya Sharma: bummer. did you get the hotel folio showing the hold as pre-auth and final bill showing posted room charge? we need the folio + cc statement line.
Maya Lopez: yeah attaching (screenshot). Folio shows: 
```
Pre-auth incidental: 300.00 GBP
Room charge: 210.00 GBP
Minibar: 34.50 GBP
Total posted: 244.50 GBP
Transaction id: PAY-LON-4521
```
No VAT breakdown. ATM receipt shows fee: 6.00 GBP, bank statement shows FX details.
expense-bot: Reminder: expenses reimbursed require original receipts and a short justification for non-standard charges. ATM fees require manager approval and are reimbursed only if fee was business-related and no corporate payment available. See policy: https://intra.redwood/finance/expenses#atm-fees
Jonah (Finance Ops): Quick policy recap: 1) Hotel incidental holds are pre-auths and not reimbursable by themselves. We only reimburse actual posted charges. 2) ATM withdrawal fees can be reimbursed if the traveler faced an unexpected card decline and the fee was necessary for business (e.g., taxi). Manager sign-off + note required. 3) For coding: posted room + incidentals -> travel:lodging; ATM fee -> travel:other (non-reclaimable).
Maya Lopez: My card was declined at check-in due to 3DS flag (bank blocked pre-auth). I paid incidentals on personal card to avoid being locked out of room. Need ATM cash to pay taxi after their card readers were offline.
Jonah (Finance Ops): OK please upload the cc statement showing the declined pre-auth and the posted charges, plus ATM receipt. Also provide manager approval and a short note saying bank blocked corp card.
Maya Lopez: uploaded. Filing note: "Corp card pre-auth declined by bank; personal card used for incidentals and ATM cash for taxi. Request reimbursement for charged amounts and ATM fee due to emergency."
Elena Rivers: Approved. I confirm Maya couldn't use corp card and that charges were business-related.
Jonah (Finance Ops): Thanks Elena. Reimbursement breakdown: 244.50 GBP (hotel posted charges) + 6.00 GBP ATM fee = 250.50 GBP. We will convert using daily FX rate 1 GBP = 1.27 USD -> USD 318.14. ATM fee is non-reclaimable VAT-wise; tagging both as travel expense with note "card declined pre-auth".
Maya Lopez: thanks. will finance need me to chase bank about the pre-auth decline for later dispute?
Jonah (Finance Ops): Optional but helpful. If bank reverses the pre-auth and posts it back to the corp card, we may need to adjust reimbursements. Leave the transaction open and email finance@redwood with any bank updates.
Maya Lopez: will do. appreciate the fast turnaround :pray:
